sentences.text: The complete skeleton of this dinosaur measured approximately 57 centimeters in length.
Its tail feathers exhibited a unique rachis-dominated morphology, suggesting specialized aerodynamic properties.
This single specimen, known for preserving plumage impressions, carries the species name barsboldi to honor Mongolian paleontologist Rinchen Barsbold.
Fossils were found in China at the type locality of the Jiufotang Formation.
Evidence suggests the individual died as a post-juvenile.
Norellraptor is classified as a microraptorine dromaeosaurid.
It was assigned to the subfamily Microraptorini and is considered a sister taxon to Zhongjianosaurus.
This animal lived during the Early Cretaceous, specifically the Barremian to Aptian stages.
It inhabited a temperate forested environment within the Jiufotang Formation.
Its environment included Sinotyrannus, Liaoconodon, Psittacosaurus, and various birds and pterosaurs.
